retrievalProfile.description: A warm, golden-hour portrait of a female artist seated against a dense floral background with high-contrast magenta and purple tones.
triggerTerms: golden hour portrait with magenta flowers
seated pose with long blonde hair and purple dress

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure with long, wavy blonde hair sits on a dark wooden bench. She wears a magenta dress that harmonizes with a lush, out-of-focus background of purple flowers. The lighting is warm and directional, creating a soft glow on her skin and hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject color matches background floral hues
Warm skin tones contrast against cool purple shadows
Sharp foreground subject against a soft bokeh background
Text framing the subject at top and bottom edges
coreInvariants: Magenta or deep purple color palette
Golden hour lighting on the subject's hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame in a seated, curled-up pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and gaze directed toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down the subject's hair to her face, follow the curve of her body to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is filled with the subject and dense floral texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and deep purple (dress and flowers)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and warm tan (hair and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purples with high value in the highlights of the hair.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright blues

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps serif with sharp terminals
Bottom text uses a fluid, slanted script with high stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, wide serif and an informal, narrow script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility against busy backgrounds

preserve: All-caps serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical, wide-tracked serif aesthetic of the top text.
Captures the elegant, high-contrast script feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with long wavy blonde hair sitting on a dark bench, wearing a magenta dress, with a background of out-of-focus purple flowers in golden hour light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a wide-tracked white serif font at the top and the album title in a white script font at the bottom right with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the top text all-caps serif?
Is the bottom text a slanted script?
Does the dress color match the background flowers?
Is there a warm glow on the hair?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the script font is legible against the subject's skin
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between subject and background
Verify the serif font is wide-tracked
Ensure the script font has high contrast
Confirm the lighting feels like golden hour
Check that the subject's pose is natural
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + [Color: Magenta/Purple] + [Lighting: Golden Hour] + [Background: Floral Bokeh] + [Typography: Serif/Script Pair]
